name: todo
description: Your to-dos with Getting Things Done, without an app: capture, clarify, choose what to do now, and a weekly review. Areas and rules are the owner's, and grow over time.

stays_local: the memory file with tasks, history and the owner's rules (the agent queries it and sees the answers)
agent_sees: task titles, next actions, areas, contexts, due dates and their history, when it queries them
everything the owner types in the conversation
cannot_guarantee: what the agent sees leaves the computer for the AI provider, under its terms
reminders happen only when the owner opens a conversation; there are no push notifications
the memory file is not encrypted
